children: VSee Health entered into a Strata Purchase Agreement providing up to $5.0 million in committed equity financing with Clearthink Capital Partners. The facility allows VSee to direct share sales over about 36 months after an SEC resale registration becomes effective, with purchases priced at 85% of the lowest closing price over the 10 trading days before each purchase. Individual draw limits apply, and Clearthink’s ownership is capped at 9.99%; VSee issued 40,000 shares as a commitment fee. Proceeds are expected to support working capital and general corporate purposes.
: Equity purchase agreement (committed equity facility up to $5.0 million)
: Enhance liquidity for working capital and general purposes
